title: Unique nondegenerate decomposition of a simplex
statement: Let $S$ be a simplicial set [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set]. For every $q\geq0$ and $z\in S_q$ there exist a unique integer $r\geq0$, a unique surjective order-preserving map $\sigma:[q]\to[r]$, and a unique nondegenerate simplex $y\in S_r$ such that $z=S(\sigma)(y)$.
